title: dedicated-autoscaler: priority-aware throughput guarantees, burst controls, and utilization reporting
author: Priya Menon
release_notes: Enhances Dedicated autoscaler with priority-aware throughput guarantees, smoother burst controls, and improved utilization reporting. Backwards compatible config additions; operators can opt-in to new policies via helm values.
description: Motivation: Dedicated fleets need predictable throughput for higher-tier customers while preserving burst capacity and delivering actionable utilization metrics. This PR implements priority-aware throughput guarantees, token-bucket based burst smoothing, and richer utilization reporting for fleet autoscaler dashboards. Summary of changes: 1) Priority throughput guarantees: add per-priority throughput floor and soft guarantees that the autoscaler attempts to maintain during normal operation while still allowing lower-priority jobs to use spare capacity. 2) Burst controls: introduce token-bucket smoothing with configurable refill rates and burst caps to avoid capacity oscillations during sudden traffic spikes. 3) Util reporting: emit new metrics and labels (priority, guarantee_level, burst_used, sustained_utilization) and add aggregation for per-fleet and per-customer dashboards. 4) Config and migration: add helm values and CRD fields with defaults that preserve existing behavior unless enabled. Checklist: - [x] Design doc (Linear ENG-4821) - [x] Unit tests for token-bucket and scheduling heuristics - [x] Integration tests for throughput guarantees under synthetic load - [x] Observability dashboards updated - [x] Docs and release notes
commits: feat(autoscaler): add priority throughput floor and soft guarantees
feat(autoscaler): token-bucket burst smoothing and config
docs: add autoscaler config reference and migration notes
diff_summary: New scheduler that respects 'priority' in request routing, token-bucket implementation added under tokenbucket/, new metrics and dashboard JSON, small config additions to helm values and OpenAPI schema. No breaking API changes; CRD extended with optional fields.
test_summary: Unit: tokenbucket and scheduler heuristics pass. Integration: synthetic load test shows 95th p50 latency preserved for priority=high while low priority throughput is throttled during constrained periods. E2E: flakey test fixed by increasing test harness timeout. CI initially failed on lint (line-length) and a race detected in scheduler unit test; both fixed in follow-up commits.

notes_for_ops: To enable priority throughput guarantees, set charts/dedicated/values.yaml -> autoscaler.priorityGuarantes.enabled=true and tune per-priority floors. Monitor new metric dedicated_autoscaler_guarantee_utilization and burst_used. Default is disabled; rollout recommended with canary on a single fleet.
backout_plan: Revert the helm values change and roll the release back via existing helm release. Autoscaler will continue operating with previous policy if new flags are unset. CRD extensions are optional and safe to ignore.
